title: Retained VirtualList Root Apply v1
problem: Retained data-table optimization moved the measured owner out of table row/cell structure and into retained VirtualList layout/root application. Current evidence still shows the hot owner in the fixed/known-height retained VirtualList first-pass child layout path under post-layout root apply, but code inspection also shows the fixed path still walks every visible child and only skips measurement. This lane now owns the decision point between a narrower retained VirtualList fast path and a possible table/row-tree-depth follow-on.

repro.summary: Run the retained data-table filter-shrink script with retained data-table mode, layout node profiling, and scroll layout profiling enabled; then inspect diag stats for retained VirtualList, Scroll, and child-layout phase attribution. The current owner is still the fixed-height retained VirtualList first-pass child layout path under post-layout root apply, but the latest code slices removed a pure test-id Semantics wrapper from retained table cell rendering, hoisted the shared horizontal body transform, and the heavy torture preview now disables per-cell debug anchors while still showing the same retained VirtualList plus Scroll owner.
commands: target/release/fretboard-dev.exe diag perf tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/data-table/ui-gallery-data-table-retained-filter-shrink-vlist-inputs-change.json --repeat 1 --warmup-frames 5 --dir target/fret-diag/retained-vlist-root-apply-m0-scroll-profile-v1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_DATA_TABLE_RETAINED=1 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE=1 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE_TOP=30 --env FRET_LAYOUT_NODE_PROFILE_MIN_US=80 --env FRET_SCROLL_LAYOUT_PROFILE=1 --env FRET_SCROLL_LAYOUT_PROFILE_MIN_US=0 --env FRET_SCROLL_LAYOUT_PROFILE_MIN_MEASURE_US=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --sort cpu_cycles --top 15 --json --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-dev,gallery-ai,gallery-chart,gallery-web-ime-harness

gates.name: retained-virtual-list-focused
gates.command: cargo nextest run --cargo-profile dev-fast -p fret-ui retained_virtual_list --no-fail-fast --no-capture

continue_policy.notes: Continue here while the owner remains retained VirtualList first-pass child layout or barrier relayout. Split a narrower follow-on if evidence says the row/cell tree itself is the dominant cost, if a fixed-track layout primitive is the next real seam, or if ownership moves to a more local retained component. The latest landed slices removed pure test-id semantics wrappers from retained table cells, hoisted the shared horizontal body transform, and disabled per-cell debug anchors in the torture preview; they lowered breadth a little, but the remaining owner is still retained VirtualList plus the parent Scroll rather than broad table-local wrapper code.
